name: upgrade
body: Upgrade: bringing an existing kalide project — a deck directory or a template library directory — forward to the format and scaffold content of the running kalide, once and in place. The capability spans both authoring scaffold (the deck root: kalide.yaml, slides/, assets/ and the deck author-guide pair — the kalide-owned full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` plus its `AGENTS.md` pointer) and templating (the library root: library.yaml, templates, themes, media and the library author-guide pair — the full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` plus its `AGENTS.md` pointer), and is driven only by the current project's own files plus the running binary's version — never the network. A refresh member — the full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` and the seed starter content — is refreshed when it is present and byte-identical to a known released kalide version of that same file; the full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` is also written when absent. The `AGENTS.md` pointer follows only the agent-guide-reference scheme, never a byte-identical whole-file rewrite: it is created carrying the embedded pointer content (agent-guide-reference) when absent; it is migrated when it is a known released full guide; the reference line is appended to it when it is author content without the string; and it is left byte-for-byte untouched when it already carries the string. The project's format is migrated forward through the registered migrations. Conservative by construction: upgrade recognizes what is still kalide's, rewrites only that, and reports the rest.
